about_the_game:
Battle for patient lives in this hospital-themed card battler! Roll dice to heal or harm as medical staff clash in chaotic wards. Rogue-like progression meets deck-building strategy in this darkly humorous take on healthcare chaos

Features

  • Dice driven combat: roll dice to gain resources, heal patients, or to go on the attack

  • Dual objectives: combat ill-intentioned staff, while also trying to protect patients caught in the crossfire

  • Rouge-like progression: when your cards fall, the run ends

  • Deck evolution: tweak and upgrade your deck between rounds

  • Random upgrades: at the end of each round there is a chance for an upgrade which can help progression in the run

Will you save lives or succumb to the chaos of understaffed wards and administrative nightmares? Every dice roll matters when patients' lives are on the line.

Perfect for fans of: Card battlers, medical dramas, dark humor, and strategic gameplay with meaningful choices.

content_descriptors.notes: The game attempts to use dark comedy to explore issues in the healthcare system. Some card names and descriptions may be unsettling when combined with personal experiences.
